content:
When Freda cooks canned tomatoes into sauce, they lose half their volume. This means the volume of sauce is half the volume of the canned tomatoes used. Freda made 32 ounces of sauce, so she must have used 32 × 2 = 64 ounces of canned tomatoes.

Each can holds 16 ounces, so she used 64 ÷ 16 = 4 cans. Each can contains 3 tomatoes, so the total number of tomatoes is 4 × 3 = 12.

Answer: 12
